entries.not_relevant_because: Both manuscripts concern the Goemans–Linial SDP and uniform sparsest cut on complete graphs with arbitrary nonnegative capacities, with the gap witnessed by a general negative-type semimetric on a finite vertex set, not by the shortest-path metric of a graph; they neither treat graphs from any proper minor-closed family nor bound the ℓ1 distortion of such metrics, so they say nothing about whether that distortion is bounded.
